quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #23
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, what should you do?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.
Keep your wheels pointed straight ahead.
Leave your transmission in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels toward the curb. If your car rolls downhill, it will hit the curb instead of rolling into traffic.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a:

options.text: Solid red light.
Stop sign.
Yield sign.
Caution sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: A red flashing light means stop completely. Look in all directions before going.

questions.question: If two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The largest vehicle.
The car on the left.
The car on the right.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the right.
questions.explanation: The driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. Which lane should you be in after the turn?

options.text: The right lane.
The center of the street.
The left lane.
The lane with the least traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane.
questions.explanation: After turning left onto a one-way street, end up in the left lane.

questions.question: When must you yield to other drivers?

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When they are on a road to your left and you both reach an unmarked intersection at the same time.
When your traffic signal is a green arrow.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: You must yield when pulling into the street from a garage, driveway, or alley.

questions.question: Your vehicle's gas pedal sticks while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn.
Press the brakes hard.
Turn on your hazard lights.
Turn off the engine carefully, then brake and move to a safe area.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the engine carefully, then brake and move to a safe area.
questions.explanation: Turn off the engine using the ignition switch. Then apply the brakes and drive to a safe spot.

questions.question: What is true about a work zone?

options.text: It can be moving or stationary.
It is marked with black and white signs.
You do not need to slow down or pay extra attention.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can be moving or stationary.
questions.explanation: Work zones can be fixed or moving. They are marked with orange signs. Slow down and stay alert in work zones.

questions.question: What does a stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully; you do not always have to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Let vehicles and pedestrians pass. Go when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalk, which side should a pedestrian walk on?

options.text: The side with the lightest traffic.
The same side traffic is moving on.
The side facing oncoming traffic.
The side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: The side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side where you can see cars coming toward you.

questions.question: What traffic light means: stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when safe?

options.text: A solid red light.
A flashing yellow light.
A solid green light.
A flashing red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, then go when safe.

questions.question: Children are playing near your driveway. What should you do before backing out?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn them.
Honk your horn.
Get out and check behind your car.
Tell the children to stay away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out and check behind your car.
questions.explanation: Always get out and look behind your car before backing up, especially when children are nearby. Do not rely only on mirrors.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
A traffic light is coming up.

questions.correctAnswerText: A traffic light is coming up.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is at the next intersection.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up next to the front car.
Back up slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up next to the front car.
questions.explanation: First, check traffic and signal. Stop next to the front car. Then turn your wheels to park.

questions.question: As a pedestrian, what should you do?

options.text: Always have the right-of-way over vehicles in a crosswalk.
Do not enter a street when vehicles are coming.
Enter a crosswalk anytime because drivers must stop.
Use crosswalks only when convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter a street when vehicles are coming.
questions.explanation: Do not enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are approaching. Even though pedestrians have the right-of-way in crosswalks, a nearby vehicle may not have time to stop.

questions.question: How should you use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before you enter the exit ramp.
Slow down once you are on the exit ramp.
Keep the same speed on the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down once you are on the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until you are on the exit ramp.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?

options.text: To pass a slow truck.
To turn into a driveway.
To pass another car.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: To turn into a driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean no passing or lane changes. You can only cross these lines to turn left into a driveway or make a U-turn where permitted.

questions.question: When must you pull over for an emergency vehicle?

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right edge and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is behind you or coming toward you.

questions.question: What does a solid black HAWK signal mean?

options.text: You may go, but drive carefully.
Slow down and get ready to stop.
Come to a complete stop.
No pedestrians are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may go, but drive carefully.
questions.explanation: HAWK signals are used at pedestrian crossings. A solid black signal means you can drive through, but stay alert.

questions.question: How can you check your blind spots when changing lanes?

options.text: Use the inside rearview mirror.
Use the outside rearview mirror.
Use both mirrors.
Turn your head to look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head to look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check your blind spots before every lane change.

questions.question: Your vehicle is blocking traffic after an accident. What should you do?

options.text: Move your vehicle off the roadway if possible.
Never move your vehicle.
Wait for police before moving your vehicle.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle off the roadway if possible.
questions.explanation: After a minor accident, move your vehicle off the roadway if you can. Do not leave the scene without identifying yourself and helping if needed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right.
Two curves ahead.
Many curves ahead on the road.
Pavement ends.

questions.correctAnswerText: Many curves ahead on the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves.

questions.question: What is a safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down as you enter, speed up as you exit.
Keep the same speed through the curve.
Speed up as you enter, slow down as you exit.
Stay near the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down as you enter, speed up as you exit.
questions.explanation: Slow down when entering a curve and speed up as you exit. Speeding up when entering makes your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: When an oncoming vehicle uses high beams, look toward ____ of the road.

options.text: Either side
The center
The right side
The left side

questions.correctAnswerText: The right side
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road when an oncoming vehicle has high beams on. This prevents you from being blinded and helps you stay on course.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line down the center mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and you can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction and you can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and you can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Broken lines mean you can pass when it is safe.

questions.question: An intersection ahead is blocked by traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Go slowly until traffic moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front.
Do not enter the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
Honk your horn to make cars move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if you cannot completely cross it. Wait until traffic clears so you do not block the intersection.
